title: GA4GH AI Registry: model entry (v1)
description: The common entry core (entry-core.v1.schema.json) plus a required pointer to a full GA4GH Genomic AI Model Card and a small index projection mirrored from the Model Card and from Hugging Face's own listing conventions (internal project documentation Section 3.5.1). Models are referenced, never embedded: the Model Card remains the single authoritative document. hosting_location + access_uri are the fields that let this entry point at a model hosted anywhere: Hugging Face, GitHub, a container registry, a self-hosted endpoint, or a gated-request-only source.

model_card_uri.description: Required. URI to a full GA4GH Genomic AI Model Card (internal project documentation Section 3.5.1, targeting Model Card v0.6.0). This is the deep-dive link the detail page renders prominently; no other Model Card content is duplicated into this entry.

pipeline_tag.description: Mirrored from Hugging Face / Model Card Section 5's pipeline tag vocabulary, e.g. "text-generation", "variant-effect-prediction".

tags.description: Mirrored from Hugging Face / Model Card Section 5.

library_name.description: Mirrored from Hugging Face / Model Card Section 5, e.g. "transformers", "pytorch".

base_model.description: Mirrored from Hugging Face / Model Card Section 5: the base or foundation model this model was fine-tuned or derived from, if any.

intended_domain.description: Model Card Section 5.3 fallback for genomic tasks with no accepted Hugging Face pipeline_tag.

hosting_location.description: Where the model itself (weights, container, or gated-access endpoint) is hosted, distinct from where its source repository lives. This is what makes an externally hosted model addressable: a Hugging Face Hub model, a model published only as a GitHub release artefact, a container image, a self-hosted inference endpoint, or a gated-request-only model with no public download.

access_uri.description: Where to access or request the model, appropriate to hosting_location, e.g. a Hugging Face Hub URL (https://huggingface.co/<org>/<model>), a GitHub Releases URL, a container registry reference, or a gated-access request form URL.

install_command.description: Copy-paste string to install or load the model, Ollama-style, e.g. a Hugging Face `pip install` and load snippet. Omitted where no meaningful install action exists (internal project documentation Section 5.3).

recommended_version.description: MLflow-alias-shaped pointer to the version a visitor should use by default, when this entry tracks more than one published version.

last_synced.description: Timestamp of the last mirror refresh of any fields on this entry sourced from an external listing (e.g. Hugging Face Hub metadata).

registry_enrichment.description: Mirrored verbatim from Model Card Section 6.8b. Documentation-completeness oriented; MUST NOT be merged with an agent entry's trust-and-behaviour-oriented agent_info_snapshot.enrichment (internal project documentation Section 3.5.1).
